# Draft:Timeline of the enlargement of NATO

The timeline for the enlargement of NATO, including the accession of member states and the list of applicant countries.
1949–present
*1949 – The North Atlantic Treaty Organization was founded by Belgium, Canada, Denmark, France, Iceland, Italy, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Norway, Portugal, the United Kingdom and the United States.
*1952 – Greece and Turkey join NATO.
*1955 – West Germany join NATO.
*1982 – Spain join NATO.
*1990 – German reunification
*1999 – the Czech Republic, Hungary and Poland join NATO.
*2004 – Bulgaria, Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania, Romania, Slovakia and Slovenia join NATO.
*2009 – Albania and Croatia join NATO.
*2017 – Montenegro join NATO.
*2020 – North Macedonia join NATO.
*2022 – Finland and Sweden have applied for membership.
*2023 – Finland join NATO.
*2024 – Sweden join NATO.

* Enlargement of NATO
* Timeline of the enlargement of the European Union
